def binary_search(arr, target):
    '''
    Perform binary search on a sorted array.
    Time complexity: O(log n)
    Space complexity: O(1)
    '''
    left, right = 0, len(arr) - 1

    while left <= right:
        mid = (left + right) // 2

        if arr[mid] == target:
            return mid
        elif arr[mid] < target:
            left = mid + 1
        else:
            right = mid - 1

    return -1
